Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the marketplace materials. Attached is v3 of our proposed product page storyboard plus the co-sell one-pager and a simple pricing matrix so the field has something concrete to present. Key asks for this week: 

- Can you confirm the hero benefit (two lines) and one supporting evidence claim below? We call out "sub-10ms inference for vector search" and want to make sure the metric maps to your benchmarks.
- Any procurement constraints on the SKU/AMI naming? Our operations team needs the final AMI tag for the listing form.
- Please confirm the co-sell one-pager content is field-ready — short bullets that the AE can read quickly on a call.

Timeline: if we can lock copy + AMI by EOD Wednesday (your timezone), we can publish to the catalog on Thursday and schedule the joint launch call for next Tuesday.

Attachments: acme-offer-storyboard-v3.pdf; co-sell-one-pager.docx; pricing-matrix.csv

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Lauren Boyd <lauren@acmedata.com>

Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@cloudpartners.io>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace Offer Storyboard + Sales Assets — Ready for Final QA

Thanks Marissa — reviewed and overall looks great. A few quick notes: 

1) Hero metric: the 10ms callout is accurate for our small-batch benchmarks (p95 on a 1k vector query) but we should avoid implying guaranteed latency at scale. Suggest "p95 ~10ms on 1k-vector queries" or similar.
2) Evidence: we can attach the benchmark summary PDF but that will need a short blurb saying "internal benchmark; results may vary".
3) AMI naming: our ops team requires the AMI to include region and version, e.g., acme-ami-us-west-2-v1.2.
4) Pricing: the matrix looks fine but procurement prefers rounding to whole dollars on the sales sheet.

I can route the benchmark PDF if helpful. Tom — looping you in for ops confirmation on the AMI naming and any marketplace constraints from the partner side.

Hi Lauren — thanks for the quick read. Inline below with suggested copy edits; I attached an updated PDF with the hero/lead bullets applied and a sales-friendly one-pager designed for the field.

Inline: 
1) Hero metric — agreed on being specific and conservative. Proposed hero: 

"Sub-10ms p95 inference on 1k-vector search (1-node, representative workload)"

Supporting bullet: "Validated on ACME benchmark harness; results may vary by dataset and scale — see benchmark appendix."

2) Evidence blurb added to the footer of the product page.

3) AMI tag example updated in the listing notes to: acme-ami-us-west-2-v1.2 (confirmed with ops as a recommended canonical tag). Rafael — can you confirm we don't need an extra AMI suffix for marketplace ingestion?

4) Pricing matrix — rounded in attached CSV; left a comment on the per-hour line for enterprise discounts.

Next steps: Rafael to confirm AMI/technical mapping, Jonas to shepherd copy to the listings form, and Marissa to confirm go/no-go on Thursday publishing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference

- SKU mapping: validated. SKUs in pricing-matrix-rounded.csv map to our billing catalog (ACME-BASIC, ACME-PRO, ACME-ENT). No additional suffixes required.
- Legal / Marketplace compliance: I flagged the benchmark blurb for Legal to sign off (DocuSign route available). Once Legal approves the evidence blurb, we can proceed with the catalog submission.

Schedule: I'll book a 30-min intake with the listings ops team tomorrow at 10:00 PT to finalize the form fields. If we close legal signoff by EOD tomorrow, ops can publish on Thursday as proposed.
